input.question: How much have firearms changed over the last seventy years?
input.ground_truth: Modern weapons are more ergonomic, reliable, and accurate due to improved manufacturing techniques. They are lighter and produce less recoil. A lot of this improvement has come in the last 20 years. You would probably have more luck posting this in a firearm-oriented sub like /r/guns.

Explain the following question in a simple way as if you are explaining to a 5-year-old.

Question: How much have firearms changed over the last seventy years?

Answer:

response.prediction:
Okay! Imagine you have a toy gun from seventy years ago. It looks and works very differently from the toy guns (or real guns) we have now.

Seventy years ago, most guns were big, heavy, and not very easy to carry. They took a long time to load and shoot again. Some needed to be pumped to shoot, and others used big, heavy bullets.

Now, guns are smaller, lighter, and can shoot many times without reloading. Some even shoot very fast, like in the movies! They use different kinds of bullets and have safety features to help people not get hurt by accident. Some guns are even made of plastic, so they don’t weigh as much.

So, in seventy years, guns have changed a lot. They are smaller, easier to use, and can do more things than before. But remember, grown-ups use real guns for serious reasons, and they are very dangerous. Toy guns are just for playing!
